known_facts_book1: Acknowledged to be the most popular and most beloved man in all the Land of Oz.
Goes into the Munchkin Country to get fresh oat-straw to stuff himself with in honor of Ozma's celebration.
Returns riding proudly on the wooden Saw-Horse at the head of a band, and waves his peaked hat to Dorothy.
Had his faded face newly painted by the Munchkin farmer who first made him, because the paint had peeled off one end of his mouth.
His hands are white gloves filled with straw; he invites Dorothy to hear him 'crunkle'.
Puzzles over Button-Bright's name, deciding he must be a dull cloth-covered button.
Walks arm in arm with Dorothy in the birthday procession and performs a sword-swallowing act at the celebration.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: An old friend he embraces warmly and walks beside in the procession.
known_relations_book1.Tin Woodman: His old comrade; the two stand on either side of the throne.
known_relations_book1.Saw-Horse: The wooden steed he rides into the city.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler whose birthday he honors with fresh straw.

known_facts_book1: Nick Chopper, the Emperor of the Winkies, known throughout Oz as the Tin Woodman, made all of tin nicely soldered at the joints.
Was once made of flesh, but chopping wood the axe cut off his parts one by one until all were replaced with tin.
Was given an excellent heart by the wonderful Wizard and says it grows softer and kindlier every day.
Has built a splendid new tin castle to replace his old damp one, with tin furniture, floors and walls.
Keeps in his gardens tin statues of his personal friends, including a life-size tin Dorothy and Toto.
Declares that money is unknown in Oz and that his people live by love and kindness instead.
Carries a tin-plated axe and travels with the party from his castle toward the Emerald City.
Tells the shaggy man the history of the Powder of Life, Mombi, the Saw-Horse, the Gump, and old Dyna's blue bear rug.
Performs Swinging the Axe and sings a love song at the birthday celebration.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: An old friend he runs out to embrace at his tin castle.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: His old comrade at the court.
known_relations_book1.Winkies: His yellow-country subjects, who love their Emperor dearly.
known_relations_book1.Wizard: The magician who gave him his heart.

known_facts_book1: A man whose body is clumsily jointed sticks of wood topped by a carved pumpkin head, now a farmer living in a hollow pumpkin in the Winkie country.
Keeps a private graveyard of three little graves for his former heads, which spoiled on April 9th, October 2nd, and January 24th.
Is now wearing his fourth head, each carved by Ozma to replace a spoiled one.
Raises his own field of pumpkins so as never to be caught without a spare head.
Was first made and brought to life by Ozma with the Magic Powder of Life, and calls Ozma his 'parent'.
Brings Ozma a necklace of pumpkin-seeds set with carolites as a birthday present.

known_relations_book1.Ozma: His maker and 'parent', who carves each of his pumpkin heads.
known_relations_book1.Tin Woodman: Who guides Dorothy to his pumpkin field and teases him about his stupid last head.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The old friend who is glad to find him still alive.

known_facts_book1: A round copper man who works entirely by machinery: his thought, his speech, and his action each wind up separately with a key.
Speaks in a jerky monotone and runs down mid-sentence into meaningless babble until he is wound again.
Was sent by Ozma with Billina to welcome Dorothy in the Winkie country, because Ozma was too busy to come herself.
Is not alive, but his machinery makes him as good as alive; he is trustworthy and reliable because he does exactly what he is wound to do.
Lives at the Royal Palace in the Emerald City.
Lets Button-Bright wind up his clockwork on the road.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: An old friend who once saved her life and Billina's; she winds him up when he runs down.
known_relations_book1.Billina: His companion, the Yellow Hen who rides on his copper shoulder.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler who sends him to welcome Dorothy and whom he serves at the palace.

known_facts_book1: A yellow hen who wears a pearl necklace and rides on Tik-tok's copper shoulder.
Was sent by Ozma with Tik-tok to welcome Dorothy in the Winkie country.
Has hatched ten lovely chicks, all of whom she has named Dorothy because it is easier when she calls them.
Dresses each chick in a gold chain and locket holding a picture of Dorothy.
Snaps at Toto and calls him a brute when he tries to attack her.
Sits with her brood at the animals' table at the banquet on a railed stand.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: Her dear old friend, after whom she names all ten chicks.
known_relations_book1.Tik-tok: Her companion, on whose shoulder she perches.
known_relations_book1.Toto: The dog who tries to attack her and is scolded by Dorothy.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler who sends her to welcome Dorothy.
